newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile publishes new electricity-generating prices.
newsitem.headline: Chile publishes new electricity-generating prices.

text.p: Chile announced Thursday new electricity-generating prices which will come into force for the next six months from Monday.
The Economy Ministry published a detailed statement in the government gazette Diario Oficial of the rates which will be applied to power companies in the central and northern grids.
The change in rates was not clear in the very complex statement. However, prices have been widely expected to fall by about 11 percent.
Power companies are expected to comment on the impact of the new rates later today.
